title: What each stop leaves behind
note: Uncommitted edits to tracked files stop it before the rebase starts.

items.name: Conflict:
items.note: names the files, aborts the rebase, branch is as it was

items.name: File over 5 MB:
items.note: names file and size, even if a later commit deletes it

items.name: Test failure:
items.note: lists up to five failing tests, nothing pushed

items.name: Push failure:
items.note: prints the e2e line and the last git message; main may have moved, run again
